title: IP to CIDR
description: Convert an IP address and a number of IPs into a list of CIDR blocks.
pseudocode:
1. Convert IP to long integer.
2. While n > 0, find largest power of 2 that fits.
3. Convert integer back to CIDR string format.

steps.note: Find largest block for 2 IPs starting at 4278190087 (mask 31)
Convert final blocks to CIDR format
